name: threedream
description: Unreal-class game and physics-AI runtime on top of three.js: deterministic ECS + fixed-timestep simulation, pluggable physics, and in-browser reinforcement learning.

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && wasm-pack build crates/physics-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../../wasm/pkg --release
scripts.build:wasm:gpu: cd rust && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p threedream-gpu
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
